artifact_policy.ci_rerun_policy: Normal CI validates committed bytes and internal recomputation without cloning or installing PyDimension.
artifact_policy.external_execution: Disposable GitHub Actions environment; read-only repository permissions; upload raw output as an Actions artifact; never auto-commit evidence.

comparison.affine_consistency_rule: Separately verify The Number Project's exact particular solution satisfies A p = dim(G), and verify p + v also satisfies A x = dim(G) for every external exact kernel vector v. PyDimension is not credited with independently solving the affine target system.
comparison.agreement_rule: AGREEMENT iff the external exact basis has the same vector-space span as The Number Project's exact nullspace basis, the ranks/nullities agree, and all external basis vectors have exact zero residual under the preregistered matrix.
comparison.disagreement_rule: Any exact span, rank/nullity, or residual mismatch is DISAGREEMENT and must be recorded without changing the rules.
comparison.external_result_used_for_verdict: primitive integer basis returned by PyDimension _simplify_basis_vectors after its SymPy exact nullspace recomputation
comparison.normalization: Treat each basis vector as an exact rational row vector and compare subspaces by exact Fraction RREF of the row-span matrix after removing zero rows. Raw basis-vector equality is forbidden.

environment.import_policy: Load PyDimension's pinned data_generation config.py and generator.py directly from the cloned checkout without importing pydimension.__init__, so unrelated ML dependencies are not required.

external_comparator.exact_path_semantics: The method recomputes Matrix(self.dimension_matrix).nullspace() with SymPy exact arithmetic, clears denominators, reduces primitive integer vectors, and only then converts those primitive entries to float for its return array.
external_comparator.float_path_semantics: The surrounding method first calls scipy.linalg.null_space. The Milestone 6A verdict must not use that floating SVD basis for exact span equality; it is recorded only as a diagnostic.
external_comparator.name: PyDimension

nonclaims: Agreement is methodological corroboration of the tested dimensional computation, not empirical evidence about gravity.
Agreement does not establish correctness of PyDimension or The Number Project generally.
The PyDimension float/SciPy nullspace is not accepted as exact evidence.
No definitional-dependency or definitional-equivalence result is independently verified by this experiment.
No value of G, physical mechanism, or novel physical law is inferred.

planted_control.comparison: Compare the control matrix's PyDimension exact nullspace against the unperturbed internal baseline nullspace. The required control outcome is DISAGREEMENT.
planted_control.construction: Copy the preregistered matrix and change the M exponent of c at row M / column c from 0 to 1.
planted_control.purpose: Prove the differential comparison can report a mismatch.

project.baseline_semantics: Merge of PR #17 / Milestone 6C; dimensional/definitional separation invariant is already pinned.
